card.name: Adjectives before enzyme and target names
card.fires_on: Small words like a, the, an, and adjectives like key or major that come right before an enzyme, pathway or drug target name. Seen in metabolism and drug-interaction passages.

modes.label: Adjective before enzyme
modes.description: Words like key or major just before an enzyme or pathway noun.
modes.example: Dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase is a<< key>> enzyme involved in the metabolism and elimination of

modes.label: Article before target
modes.description: A, an or the just before a named enzyme or drug target.
modes.example: RNA triphosphatase is<< an>> attractive target for antifungal drug development

card.writes: It slightly favors words like viral, bacterial and abundant, which suggests an adjective or class of biological target comes next.
